degree_rationale: The Five Sons of the Awakener — drawers-upward who raise the dead. Treats the essence of resurrection-power and its named forms (Resolution, Stillness, Fast, Peace, Day, Rest).
direction_rationale: Resurrection-as-illumination: drawing souls upward into the bright forms of life. Awakening is the south-mystery par excellence.
title: The Five Awakeners: how the dead are raised into resurrection
